# Floriwish (https://floriwish.com)
> India's Leading Online Flower, Cake, Hamper & Event Decoration Delivery Platform.

## About
Floriwish delivers farm-fresh flowers, designer artisan cakes, luxury gift hampers, balloon decorations, and personalized surprises across 400+ cities in India with express 2-hour, same-day, and midnight delivery options.

## Core Categories & Services
- Flowers: https://floriwish.com/flowers (Roses, Lilies, Orchids, Carnations, Mixed Bouquets, Luxury Floral Arrangements)
- Cakes: https://floriwish.com/cakes (Fresh Cream, Fondant, Pinata, Pull-me-up, Photo Cakes, Eggless options)
- Combos: https://floriwish.com/combos (Flowers with Cakes, Chocolates, Teddy Bears, Personalized Cards)
- Decorations: https://floriwish.com/balloon-decorations (Birthdays, Anniversaries, Romantic Room Setups, Baby Showers, Corporate Events)
- Plants: https://floriwish.com/plants (Indoor, Air-purifying, Bonsai, Succulents)
- Occasions: Birthday, Anniversary, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Festivals
